name: Prompt-Matcher (LLM-Prompted Schema Matching)
executive_summary: Use LLM prompting to reduce uncertainty in schema-matching tasks — deciding which fields across two different data schemas refer to the same underlying concept.
description: Applies prompting to the data-integration problem of schema matching: given two schemas (e.g. from different databases or APIs), prompts the model to assess candidate field correspondences and resolve ambiguous or low-confidence matches, reducing the manual review burden in schema-matching pipelines.
when_to_use: Integrating data from multiple schemas where field correspondence is not already known with certainty.
when_not_to_use: Schemas are already fully mapped, or field names are unambiguous enough that matching is trivial.
known_pitfalls: High-confidence-looking matches can still be wrong when field names are superficially similar but semantically distinct (e.g. two different meanings of 'status').

primary_source.title: Prompt-Matcher: Uncertainty-Guided Schema Matching with LLM Prompting
